messages:
Iris: Candidate Javier confirmed for hybrid panel Fri 8:00am PT / 16:00 CET. He asked for wheelchair-accessible room and a place to plug a power wheelchair. cc @Maya @Sam
Maya: Noted. I'll reserve an accessible room on 2F near elevator and mark an outlet by the chair. Also will add a quiet prep space for 30 mins before the panel.
Sam: Panel will be split between onsite panel and remote panelists in EU. Can we set up a hub laptop with wired ethernet and a long mic so remote folks can hear clearly?
Facilities: Room 2-4 has accessible layout and a floor outlet. We can add a power extension and a wireless boundary mic. We'll place a sign at reception to escort Javier.
Maya: Travel stipend: Javier is taking a regional train; he asked if train receipts are reimbursable. Yes  we reimburse coach rail with receipt up to $120. Please DM receipts after.
Iris: Javier prefers vegan lunch and low-fragrance room. I've DM'd his phone for arrival ETA.
Maya: Invite updated with host-only notes and door code. I'll leave a printed escort note at reception and reserve the prep room 7:30:30.
Sam: Thanks  I'll ensure someone tests AV at 7:45 and bring an HDMI adapter.
Iris: Closing loop  I'll confirm ETA morning of. :white_check_mark:
